stable_identity.species_or_base_form: a tall anthropomorphic gray wolf with a humanoid body plan
stable_identity.body_plan: broad shoulders, deep chest, digitigrade legs, five-fingered hands, long tail
stable_identity.proportions: head slightly compact against a large upper torso; long forearms; narrow waist
stable_identity.head_and_face: upright triangular ears, long but compact muzzle, heavy brows, cyan eyes
stable_identity.surfaces_and_markings: cool gray fur, pale muzzle and chest, charcoal cheek wedges and forearm markings
stable_identity.appendages: two upright ears and one long gray tail with a dark tip
stable_identity.asymmetry_rules: one cyan stud on the subject-left upper ear rim; the opposite ear has no stud
stable_identity.identity_accessories: small cyan stud earring is identity-level; clothing and carried items are scene state
stable_identity.performance_vocabulary: ears react before the head; tension appears first in the left hand and shoulders

continuity_rules: human-like head hair is explicitly not part of this identity
cranial fur remains part of the regional fur map
raised or wet cranial fur remains scene-specific character state
muzzle and cheek fur remain surface anatomy rather than human facial hair
temporary jaw shadow does not become a beard

geometry.asymmetry: expression may tilt one brow while the stable wedge shapes remain

continuity_rules: brow wedges remain separate from eye markings
expression changes angle rather than base thickness
lash treatment remains subordinate to the cyan eyes
eyeliner-like shadow does not become extra lashes
the character has no separate mane structure
the cheek and neck ruff does not expand into a shoulder mane

ruff-cheeks-neck.location: lower cheeks, jaw sides, and upper neck

geometry.boundary_and_extent: dense cheek fur begins below the eye line, follows both jaw sides, and tapers into the upper neck before the shoulders
geometry.length: medium, longer than the short cranial and muzzle fur
geometry.density: dense and full without obscuring the jaw attachment
geometry.direction: sweeps outward from the cheeks and then downward along the neck
geometry.texture: dense short-to-medium coarse wolf fur grouped into broad readable tufts
geometry.color: cool gray with the pale muzzle transition remaining separate
geometry.silhouette_role: broadens the lower face and creates a stable cheek-to-neck taper

continuity_rules: ruff boundary and cheek-to-neck taper remain stable across views
temporary wetness or raised fur changes state but not permanent ruff extent

fur-body-limbs.location: torso, arms, hands, legs, and feet outside the separately declared chest and marking zones

geometry.boundary_and_extent: continuous biological fur covers the body and limbs up to the claw bases while preserving garment and accessory boundaries
geometry.length: short to medium, slightly fuller at joints and outer forearms
geometry.density: dense and even over the body plan
geometry.direction: follows local anatomy from torso outward along each limb
geometry.texture: dense wolf fur with broad grouped tufts rather than human body hair
geometry.color: cool gray with pale chest and charcoal forearm zones owned by the marking map
geometry.silhouette_role: rounds muscular landmarks without changing the declared body proportions

continuity_rules: fur remains continuous at anatomical joints and separate from clothing
temporary wetness, sweat, compression, or disorder remains scene-specific state
temporary paw-fur dampness is owned by /appearance_state/grooming/fur_wetness/paws and never changes permanent limb-fur density or extent

fur-head-muzzle.location: cranial surface, ears, brows, cheeks outside the ruff, and muzzle

geometry.boundary_and_extent: short cranial and muzzle fur follows the ear bases, brow wedges, cheek markings, nose boundary, and mouth edge
geometry.length: short on the muzzle and crown, slightly longer around the cheek transition
geometry.density: dense with clear facial landmark visibility
geometry.direction: radiates from the crown and muzzle bridge toward the cheek and neck transitions
geometry.texture: short dense wolf fur with restrained tufting
geometry.color: cool gray, pale muzzle, and charcoal brow and cheek zones as declared by the marking map
geometry.silhouette_role: preserves the compact canine head while keeping ears, muzzle, and jaw readable

continuity_rules: cranial fur does not become human-like head hair
facial markings and ruff boundaries remain stable through expression and pose
temporary brow-fur dampness is owned by /appearance_state/grooming/fur_wetness/brow and never changes the permanent brow wedges or cranial-fur map

fur-tail.location: entire tail from the tail base to the terminal tip

geometry.boundary_and_extent: continuous fur follows the full tail with a stable dark terminal zone
geometry.length: medium and slightly fuller than torso fur
geometry.density: dense with a readable outer contour
geometry.direction: flows from tail base toward the tip
geometry.color: cool gray with a stable dark tip
geometry.silhouette_role: creates the approved long tapered tail contour

continuity_rules: tail fur direction follows the tail axis without changing tail anatomy
the dark tip boundary and overall tail silhouette remain stable

geometry.visible_digit_count: five fingered hands when fully visible; hidden digits remain unknown
geometry.length_relative_to_terminal_digit: exposed claw length is about one sixth of the terminal digit length
geometry.free_edge_length: short exposed point beyond each fingertip
geometry.shape: broad tapered canine claws with rounded triangular points
geometry.taper_and_curvature: gentle downward curve with modest taper
geometry.cuticle_or_base_transition: claw base emerges cleanly from the terminal digit fur
geometry.per_digit_variation: thumb claw is slightly broader while remaining in the same family
geometry.damage_or_missing_segments: intact unless a state event declares damage

continuity_rules: each visible claw belongs to one declared digit
claw length remains proportionate to the terminal digit
camera foreshortening does not change the stable shape family
claw dirt is current appearance state; polish color, decoration, or finish changes require an approved Appearance Variant Contract

identity_lock_fields: dense medium cheek and upper-neck ruff with a stable cheek-to-neck taper
regional cranial, body, limb, and tail fur boundaries, direction, texture, color, and silhouette roles
short canine claw shape; color and finish follow the declared variant fields

geometry.amount: moderate, with dense fur and flesh rounding the landmarks
geometry.distribution: full cheeks, broad jaw, neck, shoulders, torso, and joints
geometry.landmark_visibility: major landmarks remain readable but never protrude as sharp ridges

geometry.cheek_mass: full rounded canine cheek mass from eye line to broad jaw
geometry.cheekbone_ridge: submerged beneath fur and soft tissue
geometry.jaw_corner: broad with a smooth rounded turn
geometry.hollowing: no gaunt or carved cheek hollows
geometry.plane_transition: large rounded planes with restrained soft transitions

geometry.landmark_prominence: moderate landmarks under dense fur and muscular mass
geometry.muscle_handoffs: clear but rounded handoffs between shoulder, arm, chest, and forearm
geometry.face_body_coherence: the broad rounded facial frame matches the broad rounded body frame

coherence_rules: face and body use one declared frame character
muscularity and body weight do not create an unapproved chiseled or gaunt face
diagnostic_misreadings: fine angular face on the broad body

anchor_fragments.wording: one small cyan stud on the subject-left upper ear rim
electric-cyan eyes beneath thick charcoal brows
paired charcoal cheek wedges on pale cheek fur

coverage_requirements.notes: must show eye color and cheek markings

camera_height.offset: camera center stays level with the declared landmark for neutral measurement

coverage_landmarks.top: clearance above the highest visible head feature
coverage_landmarks.bottom: complete feet or lowest support-contact point
coverage_landmarks.left: clearance beyond the subject-left visible contour
coverage_landmarks.right: clearance beyond the subject-right visible contour

camera.nearest_form: the declared reference subject or identity detail
camera.perspective_scale_change: minimal scale change across the measured subject
required_visible_elements: complete head silhouette
complete torso and appendage attachments
both hands or forepaws when anatomically present
complete legs and feet or hind paws
focal_sequence: surface, marking, hair, mane, and ruff boundaries when present
stability_invariants: camera remains level and low-distortion
declared shot scale and crop do not drift
subject proportions remain measurable across the frame
no scene storytelling obscures identity coverage
